title: A task from start to finish
desc: You say what you want. The AI writes a plan, which fresh AIs check, and cuts it into small tickets. Then, for each ticket in turn: the tests are locked, the AI builds until they pass, and the server checks again and merges. When the AI is stuck, the advisor decides. At the end, you read the report.

nodes.text:
You say what you want
In plain words

The AI writes a plan
Fresh AIs check it

It cuts the plan into tickets
Each one small

Tests are written, then locked
Before any code

The AI builds
Until the locked tests pass

The server checks and merges
It runs the tests again

You read the report
Done, and still to do

The advisor decides
A second AI, or you
